name: How do you handle lost kitchen storage when removing dividing walls?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle lost kitchen storage when removing dividing walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing walls often eliminates upper wall cabinets, but thoughtful layout redesigns recover this space effectively. Contractors frequently replace lost wall storage by installing an expanded kitchen island with double-sided base cabinets, adding a dedicated walk-in or reach-in pantry, and utilizing deep pull-out drawers for pots and dishes. Custom cabinetry can also be designed up to the ceiling on remaining perimeter walls to maximize vertical storage while preserving an open, uncluttered aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lost wall storage is recovered through oversized kitchen islands with base cabinets, perimeter cabinetry extended to the ceiling, and built-in pantries.
